description: Had written the line. He did not write a share under it.
name: John Heminges

description: Kept the wooing at half and would not have the last line in his ear.
name: Richard Burbage

description: Confirmed the three cues and did not ask for the reason.
name: Richard Cowley

description: Asked about the reward and did not take a roll.
name: Thomas Pope

description: Read the line and did not add a sum.
name: William Shakespeare
